NGXLOOKUP.s_dictionary_verb_transitive_en: A transitive verb is a verb that needs a direct object (e.g. “She reads a book”)
NGXLOOKUP.s_dictionary_verb_intransitive_en: An intransitive verb is a verb that does not take a direct object (e.g. “He sleeps”)
NGXLOOKUP.s_dictionary_verb_both_en: Some verbs can be both transitive and intransitive depending on context (e.g. "She runs a company" (transitive), "she runs every morning" (intransitive))
NGXLOOKUP.s_dictionary_verb_transitive_fr: A transitive verb is a verb that needs a direct object (e.g. “Elle lit un livre”)
NGXLOOKUP.s_dictionary_verb_intransitive_fr: An intransitive verb is a verb that does not take a direct object (e.g. “Il dort”)
NGXLOOKUP.s_dictionary_verb_both_fr: Some verbs can be both transitive and intransitive depending on context (e.g. "Il a monté les valises" (transitive), "il est monté au premier étage" (intransitive))
